equation: A = R * K * LS * C * P  [t/ha/yr]
assumptions: Plough-layer OC = depth-weighted 0-15 cm (0-5 & 5-15 cm SoilGrids).
Slope length not measured; 100 m assumed (varied 50-150 m).

R.source: Panagos et al. 2015, Rainfall erosivity in Europe (STOTEN 511:801-814)
R.assumption: Literature-derived estimate for SW France / Aude; ESDAC R raster requires login (not accessed). Scenario range stated explicitly. NOT derived from raw ERA5 rainfall totals.

K.method: Williams (1995) EPIC from SoilGrids sand/silt/clay/OC x0.1317 -> SI
K.unit: t ha h ha-1 MJ-1 mm-1
K.assumption: Texture normalised to 100%; plough-layer OC depth-weighted (0-15 cm). Structure/permeability not required by the Williams estimator.

LS.method: McCool 1987 (S) + RUSLE L with slope-dependent m
LS.assumption: Representative slope length 100 m (field-scale); varied 50-150 m.

C.source: Panagos et al. 2015, C-factor at European scale (Land Use Policy 48:38-50)
C.assumption: Conventional arable legume/cereal baseline; improved = cover crops + reduced tillage.

P.assumption: P=1 when no support practice declared; contour/strip practices lower P.

disclaimer: Model-estimated erosion potential under stated assumptions; not a field measurement. Coverage: single study area (Castelnaudary), not nationwide.
